images.name: 성장
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustration for one selectable dungeon card in a Korean fantasy RPG web game. Generate ONE standalone portrait image, EXACT 2:3 aspect ratio, target 1024x1536 pixels. Full bleed edge-to-edge opaque artwork, no frame. Cohesive premium anime RPG environment concept art, crisp designed silhouettes, detailed painterly stone and metal surfaces, clean cel-informed lighting, cinematic atmospheric depth; polished illustration rather than photography or photorealistic 3D. The five-card set should share the same centered architectural perspective, moderate low-angle camera, detail density, and painted finish. Keep the principal landmark in the middle 70% of the composition so it stays readable in a narrow card; bottom 12% should be quieter and darker for a UI name label added later. Scene must remain readable at thumbnail size. NO people, NO characters, NO text or letters or numbers or legible runes, NO logos, NO UI, NO borders, NO watermark.  Scene: A vast luminous crystal cavern used as a sanctuary of growth: a central staircase ascends toward a magnificent branching formation of translucent pale turquoise crystals, with three naturally sized crystal growths at its base. Mint and teal light, soft warm gold accents, a sense of gathering life energy. Clear stone walkway leading into depth.
